title: Included Thermostat Allowance Across a Customer's Gas Portfolio — Residential Natural Gas Supply
content:
Included smart thermostats on Residential Natural Gas Supply plans are limited across the customer's whole gas portfolio, not per agreement.

**Rule.** A thermostat ships only while the customer's count of shipped thermostats is below the plan's per-customer thermostat limit. The count is the number of the customer's gas agreements, in any status and over all time, that show a thermostat ship date. An agreement whose plan includes a thermostat but whose customer has reached the limit receives no thermostat and no substitute credit, and therefore can never incur a thermostat recovery fee.

**Basis.** The count is read from the company's records of the customer's gas agreements — the thermostat ship date on each agreement held under the same customer number — before any shipment.

### Judgement table

| Customer's shipped-thermostat count compared with the per-customer limit | Effect of this limit on a further agreement whose plan includes a thermostat |
|---|---|
| below the limit | the limit does not bar a shipment |
| at the limit | no thermostat, no substitute credit, and no thermostat recovery fee can ever arise on that agreement |

### Illustration (hypothetical)

A customer's first agreement, on Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 36, shipped a thermostat; that agreement later closed. The customer enrolls another premise on Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24, whose per-customer limit is one. The closed agreement still shows a ship date and still counts, so the count of one equals the limit: the new agreement receives no thermostat, no substitute credit, and can never incur a recovery fee.
